segments.text: This video demonstrates the donning and doffing of the following PPE.
segments.zh: 本视频演示以下个人防护装备的穿戴和脱卸：

segments.text: Gown, gloves, disposable face mask, and face shield.
segments.zh: 隔离衣、手套、一次性口罩和面屏。

segments.text: It also demonstrates removing the gown first and the glove second when doffing.
segments.zh: 它还演示了脱卸时先脱隔离衣、再摘手套的做法。

segments.text: The first step is to remove personal items such as jewelry, watches, coats, jackets, cell phones,
segments.zh: 第一步是取下个人物品，比如首饰、手表、外套、夹克、手机、

segments.text: pens, or additional bags, and place them in a location outside of the laboratory.
segments.zh: 笔或其他包，把它们放在实验室外的某个地方。

segments.text: Then, tie back any long hair if present.
segments.zh: 然后，如果有长发，要把头发扎起来。

segments.text: Next, gather your solid front wrap-around gown with knit cuffs, a single pair of gloves,
segments.zh: 接下来，准备好前襟完整、包裹式、带针织袖口的隔离衣，一副手套，

segments.text: a disposable face mask, or an N95 respirator, and your disposable face shield.
segments.zh: 一个一次性口罩或一个 N95 呼吸器，以及你的一次性面屏。

segments.text: The decision whether to use a disposable face mask or an N95 respirator
segments.zh: 使用一次性口罩还是 N95 呼吸器，

segments.text: will depend on the laboratory site-specific and activity-specific risk assessment.
segments.zh: 取决于针对实验室场所和具体活动的风险评估。

segments.text: Please note, this scenario will demonstrate donning and doffing a disposable face mask.
segments.zh: 请注意，本场景将演示一次性口罩的穿戴和脱卸。

segments.text: Make sure you have the right size gown and gloves, and don't forget to visually inspect
segments.zh: 确保隔离衣和手套的尺码合适，别忘了目视检查

segments.text: all of your PPE for rips, tears, loose or missing straps, and replace any defective PPE you find.
segments.zh: 所有个人防护装备，看有没有破口、撕裂、松脱或缺失的系带，发现任何有缺陷的个人防护装备都要更换。

segments.text: Next, pull on the gown, fastening it securely behind your neck and back or side.
segments.zh: 接下来，穿上隔离衣，在颈后以及背后或侧面系牢。

segments.text: Do not tie the knot or fasten it so tightly that you cannot easily remove it later.
segments.zh: 不要打死结，也不要系得太紧，以免之后不容易脱下来。

segments.text: Make sure the gown fits well to allow for easy movement.
segments.zh: 确保隔离衣合身，便于活动。

segments.text: Street clothing should not be exposed.
segments.zh: 日常衣物不应外露。

segments.text: Next, put on your disposable face mask with the ear loops behind your ears,
segments.zh: 接下来，戴上一次性口罩，把耳挂挂在耳后，

segments.text: ensuring a snug fit against your face.
segments.zh: 确保口罩紧贴面部。

segments.text: With the index finger of both hands, press down on each side of the flexible nose piece
segments.zh: 用双手食指按压柔性鼻夹的两侧，

segments.text: so that the top of the face mask fits snugly against your nose and cheeks.
segments.zh: 使口罩上缘紧贴鼻子和脸颊。

segments.text: Next, put on the disposable face shield.
segments.zh: 接下来，戴上一次性面屏。

segments.text: Stretch to expand the elastic strap and place it behind your head with the foam resting
segments.zh: 拉伸弹力带，把它放到脑后，让泡沫垫正好位于

segments.text: just above your eyebrows. Adjust the strap so it fits snugly against your face.
segments.zh: 眉毛上方。调整弹力带，使其紧贴面部。

segments.text: Face shields must cover your forehead, extend below your chin, and wrap around the sides of your face.
segments.zh: 面屏必须覆盖前额，向下延伸到下巴以下，并包围面部两侧。

segments.text: Finally, put on your gloves. First, pull the gown's knit cuff down around the palm of your hand,
segments.zh: 最后，戴上手套。首先，把隔离衣的针织袖口向下拉到手掌处，

segments.text: and then pull the glove over, not under, the cuff. This helps ensure your sleeves won't slip out
segments.zh: 然后把手套拉起来套在袖口外面，而不是塞在袖口里面。这有助于确保袖子不会滑出来，

segments.text: and the knit cuff won't be exposed to hazardous materials during work.
segments.zh: 工作时针织袖口也不会接触到危险物质。

segments.text: Ensure, yet again, that there are no punctures or tears in the gloves prior to beginning work.
segments.zh: 开始工作前，再次确保手套没有刺破或撕裂。

segments.text: The following steps describe one method and sequence of doffing PPE.
segments.zh: 以下步骤介绍一种脱卸个人防护装备的方法和顺序。

segments.text: Other methods and sequences may vary based on the laboratory site-specific and activity-specific risk
segments.zh: 其他方法和顺序可能因针对实验室场所和具体活动的风险

segments.text: assessments, the procedures being conducted, and the PPE worn. The first step of doffing your PPE
segments.zh: 评估、所进行的操作程序以及所穿戴的个人防护装备而有所不同。脱卸个人防护装备的第一步

segments.text: is removing your gown. To do this, untie the gown at your waist, grasp the gown's shoulders,
segments.zh: 是脱下隔离衣。具体做法是：解开腰部的系带，抓住隔离衣的肩部，

segments.text: and pull the gown forward, releasing the neck closure. Pull the gown off of your shoulders
segments.zh: 把隔离衣向前拉，使颈部的系扣松开。把隔离衣从肩上脱下，

segments.text: and away from your body, rolling the gown inside out as you go. Before completely pulling off
segments.zh: 拉离身体，一边脱一边把隔离衣里朝外卷起来。在完全脱下

segments.text: the gown sleeves, carefully pull the gown sleeves from under your gloves and remove
segments.zh: 隔离衣袖子之前，小心地把袖子从手套下面抽出来，再把

segments.text: your arms, leaving your gloves on. Roll the gown inside out into a bundle, taking care to
segments.zh: 手臂抽出，手套仍然戴着。把隔离衣里朝外卷成一团，注意

segments.text: prevent the potentially contaminated outside of the gown from touching your street clothes.
segments.zh: 防止隔离衣可能被污染的外表面接触到你的日常衣物。

segments.text: Dispose of the bundle into the biohazard waste container. Next, slowly and gently remove your
segments.zh: 把这一团丢进生物危害废物容器。接下来，缓慢、轻柔地摘下

segments.text: gloves. These steps describe one method of removing gloves to avoid contamination.
segments.zh: 手套。这些步骤介绍的是一种避免污染的摘手套方法。

segments.text: Other methods may be used based on your institutional preferences.
segments.zh: 也可以根据你所在机构的偏好采用其他方法。

segments.text: To begin, make an L with your thumb and first finger. Then, place your fingers perpendicular
segments.zh: 首先，用拇指和食指摆成一个 L 形。然后把手指垂直于

segments.text: to your wrist and pinch. Next, pull the glove completely off. It should now be inside out.
segments.zh: 手腕放置并捏住。接下来，把手套完全脱下来。这时它应该是里朝外翻过来的。

segments.text: Grab the inside out glove with your bare hand, the one the glove just came off of,
segments.zh: 用刚脱下手套的那只裸手抓住这只翻过来的手套，

segments.text: and then pinch the other glove at the wrist. Then, pull the pinched glove up high and away
segments.zh: 然后在手腕处捏住另一只手套。接着把捏住的手套向上拉高，远离

segments.text: from the wrist. Pull the glove off, making sure the gloved hand is flat and don't touch
segments.zh: 手腕。把手套脱下来，确保戴手套的那只手保持平展，并且不要用干净的手碰到

segments.text: the outside of the contaminated glove with your clean hand. Last, discard the gloves
segments.zh: 被污染手套的外表面。最后，把手套丢进

segments.text: into the biohazard waste container. Remember, do not reuse the gloves.
segments.zh: 生物危害废物容器。记住，手套不要重复使用。

segments.text: Apply alcohol-based hand sanitizer with at least 60% ethanol or 70% isopropanol to your hands,
segments.zh: 在手上涂抹含至少 60% 乙醇或 70% 异丙醇的酒精类免洗手消毒剂，

segments.text: wash your hands with soap and water, or don a new pair of gloves.
segments.zh: 用肥皂和水洗手，或者戴上一副新手套。

segments.text: Tilt your head slightly forward to take off your face shield. Grasp the straps above the ears
segments.zh: 把头稍微前倾，摘下面屏。抓住耳朵上方的弹力带，

segments.text: and gently lift the face shield away from your face, taking care to avoid contaminating the
segments.zh: 轻轻地把面屏从面部抬离，注意避免污染

segments.text: shield itself, which may be potentially contaminated. Then, discard the disposable
segments.zh: 面屏本身，因为它可能已经被污染。然后把一次性

segments.text: face shield in the biohazard waste container. To remove your disposable face mask, remove
segments.zh: 面屏丢进生物危害废物容器。摘下一次性口罩时，取下

segments.text: the ear loops, taking care to avoid touching the potentially contaminated exterior surface
segments.zh: 耳挂，注意避免碰到口罩可能被污染的外表面。

segments.text: of the face mask. Pull the mask away from your face and dispose of it in the biohazard
segments.zh: 把口罩从面部拿开，丢进生物危害

segments.text: waste container. Last, wash your hands with soap and water. Lather the backs of your hands,
segments.zh: 废物容器。最后，用肥皂和水洗手。把手背、

segments.text: between your fingers and under your nails, and scrub for at least 20 seconds.
segments.zh: 指缝和指甲下面都打上泡沫，搓洗至少 20 秒。

segments.text: Washing your hands with soap and water is the best method. However, if soap and water are
segments.zh: 用肥皂和水洗手是最好的方法。不过，如果没有肥皂和水，

segments.text: unavailable, an alcohol-based hand sanitizer containing at least 60% ethanol or 70% isopropanol
segments.zh: 可以临时使用含至少 60% 乙醇或 70% 异丙醇的酒精类免洗手消毒剂，

segments.text: can be used as a temporary solution until soap and water are available.
segments.zh: 直到有肥皂和水为止。

segments.text: Additional considerations. Clothed-toed shoes with solid and impermeable uppers
segments.zh: 其他注意事项：鞋面结实、不透水的包头鞋

segments.text: should be worn in the laboratory. PPE will vary based on a laboratory site-specific and
segments.zh: 应在实验室里穿着。个人防护装备会根据针对实验室场所和

segments.text: activity-specific risk assessment. Donning and doffing areas should be physically separated
segments.zh: 具体活动的风险评估而有所不同。穿戴区和脱卸区应在物理上相互隔开，

segments.text: from each other to avoid contamination of clean PPE and personal belongings
segments.zh: 以免干净的个人防护装备和个人物品

segments.text: with potentially contaminated PPE. Donning and doffing procedures vary per institution.
segments.zh: 被可能被污染的个人防护装备污染。各机构的穿戴和脱卸程序各不相同。

segments.text: Follow institutional policies and procedures. For additional training and workforce development
segments.zh: 请遵循所在机构的政策和程序。如需更多培训和人员发展

segments.text: resources, please visit cdc.gov slash lab training and click on the job aids button.
segments.zh: 资源，请访问 cdc.gov/labtraining，并点击“Job Aids”（工作辅助资料）按钮。
